eyebrow: ABOUT ME: FROM OFFSHORE RIGS TO FINTECH
heading: An engineer's rigor with a product maker's empathy.
paragraphs: I began my professional career as a **Wireline Field Engineer at Schlumberger (SLB)**, commanding high-stakes offshore and onshore drilling operations where equipment failures or miscalculations carried zero margin for error.

That baptism of fire forged my approach to product management: **deterministic engineering reliability at the foundation**, wrapped in an empathetic, joyful user interface that solves real pain points.
pullQuote: Engineer mindset × PM heart. My approach is built on extreme rigor: deterministic reliability at the platform base, layered with empathetic, human-centered interfaces that delight.
closingParagraph: Over the past 5+ years at **Hijra Group**, I applied this philosophy to build digital banking rails from scratch, direct core banking overhauls, orchestrate central bank open APIs, and deploy conversational LLM copilots.

illustration.alt: Career Progression: From Offshore Wireline Rig Engineer to AI Product Manager
